evidence.claim: Users can upgrade from Hobby (free) to Pro (paid) directly in the Vercel dashboard, indicating a self-serve paid access model.
evidence.quote: I have a Hobby account, how do I upgrade to a paid plan? Thanks for continuing to use Vercel! You can upgrade to Pro directly in the Vercel dashboard.

Xero MCP Server This is a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server implementation for Xero. It provides a bridge between the MCP protocol and Xero's API, allowing for standardized access to Xero's accounting and business features.
